subject: Hosted API rate card & minimum monthly floor options
messages:
From: Michael Lee <michael@zoomly.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API — minimum monthly spend / rate card question

Hi Marissa,

Quick intro: I’m Michael (Head of Platform at Zoomly). We’re evaluating hosted LLM APIs to power search summaries and chat assist across our product. Before we schedule a deep dive, can you send your current hosted API rate card and explain any minimum monthly spend / "floor" options you offer?

We expect ~2M tokens/month to start, with spike-to-spike variability. A few specific questions:
- Do you require a monthly minimum, or is pay-as-you-go available?
- If there is a minimum, what are the typical starter bands and discount tiers?
- Do you offer pilot credits or short-term pilot pricing (3 months) without a long-term commit?
- How are overages handled if we exceed a baseline?

If you could attach a one-page summary or your rate card that’d be great. Also flag any procurement/PO requirements for a US startup.

Thanks,
Michael Lee
Head of Platform | Zoomly
procurement@zoomly.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Michael Lee <michael@zoomly.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API — minimum monthly spend / rate card question

Hi Michael — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the clear questions. I’m looping in Aditya (pricing lead) to make sure we cover contract and PO details.

Short answer up front: we support both pay-as-you-go and small monthly floors. We typically recommend a pilot path that avoids a long-term dedicated commitment while giving predictable economics for early usage. Attached is our current hosted rate card (redwood-hosted-ratecard-v2.pdf) — page 1 has a short-band summary.

Key options you’ll see in the attached:
- Pay-as-you-go: no minimum, tokens billed at list per-token rates. Best for very light / experimental usage.
- Starter floor (month-to-month): $1,200/mo baseline for up to 3M prompt+completion tokens per month; no term required, billed monthly. Overage billed at list - no additional discount.
- Committed bands (6/12 months): deeper unit discounts when you commit to a monthly baseline (examples in doc). Example: 12-mo commit at $4k/mo -> ~18% effective discount versus PAYG at your projected volume.
- Pilot credits: we can provide up to $5k in pilot credits for a short-term PoC that can be applied to the first invoice if you convert to a paid plan.

Other notes:
- We don’t require dedicated capacity for any of these options — hosted only.
- Overage and burst behaviour: bursts above baseline are allowed; overage billed monthly at either list or tiered overage rate depending on the band.
- Procurement: we accept standard US vendor PO + Net30. DocuSign order forms for prepay/commit are available.

If you want, Aditya can share a short matrix with exact per-token numbers for your 2M/month profile and a few different baseline bands. Would you prefer a 3-month pilot quote or a 12-month committed quote to compare?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Rep | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood-hosted-ratecard-v2.pdf (summary page and band table)

From: Michael Lee <michael@zoomly.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API — minimum monthly spend / rate card question

Thanks Marissa — that helps. Two quick follow-ups after glancing at the PDF:

1) We prefer limited-term pilots before multiyear commitments. Can you do a 3-month pilot with a lower baseline (e.g., $700/mo) and a clear overage rate? We’re cautious about committing to $1,200/mo before we see production traffic.
2) If we prepay 6 months up front, what discount can you offer on the starter band? Is there a minimum 6-mo prepay tier?
3) Security/compliance: do your hosted terms allow for IP/data retention controls (e.g., 30-day retention, option to disable data use for model training)? We’ll need SOC2 and basic logging for procurement.

If possible, send a sample order form so our procurement team can start an internal run — they’ll want the PO language and payment terms.

Michael

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Michael Lee <michael@zoomly.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, procurement@zoomly.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API — minimum monthly spend / rate card question

Hi Michael — Aditya here (pricing). Appreciate the questions. I’ll keep it practical.

Proposal options tailored for Zoomly (2M tokens/mo baseline):
A) 3-month pilot (no long-term commitment): $900/month starter baseline, covers up to 3M tokens/month. Overage charged at $0.00045 per token (billed monthly). We’ll apply up to $3k in pilot credits upfront if you sign within 30 days.

B) Month-to-month starter (no term): $1,200/month baseline for up to 3M tokens. Overage at $0.0005/token. No prepay required.

C) 6-month prepay (discounted): prepay 6 months at $5,400 total (equivalent to $900/mo) — effectively ~10% off compared to paying month-to-month. We can issue an invoice and accept PO + wire/ACH.

D) 12-month commit: commit to $4,800/mo baseline (higher band) with stepped discounts at volume; we’d recommend only if you expect growth to >10M tokens/mo within 12 months.

Other answers:
- Data & compliance: hosted customers can opt out of data being used to improve models and can set a 30-day retention window. We are SOC 2 Type II compliant; I can provide the security package (SSAE/SOC2 report) to procurement.
- Overages & bursting: bursts allowed; if you hit sustained >2x baseline for a month we’ll reach out to discuss bandwidth planning but won’t abruptly terminate access.
- Procurement language: attached is a clean order-form draft (ZMY-order-form-draft.docx). It lists Net30, PO acceptance, and the prepay invoice language. DocuSign link can be provided when you’re ready.

Next steps I suggest: pick option A (3-month pilot) or C (6-month prepay) and I’ll prepare a DocuSign order form and HubSpot deal. If you need legal redlines we can accept a short SOW instead of a full MSA for pilots.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Pricing Lead | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

Attachments: ZMY-order-form-draft.docx
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/ZMY-2026-045

Aditya / Marissa — appreciate the quick breakdown. Pilot option A looks like the right path. One quick ask before we sign: can the $3k pilot credit be applied to the 6-month prepay if we convert early, or is it strictly for offsetting the pilot invoices? Our procurement prefers rolling credits into an upfront prepay rather than separate small invoices.

If yes, we’ll request a DocuSign order form and target signature this week. Also please send the SOC2 package to procurement@zoomly.ai.

Thanks,
Michael
